owner: SRCE / HR-ZOO; University of Rijeka site
notes: SRCE's HR-ZOO project description says five data centers were constructed or adapted and equipped in Osijek, Rijeka, Split, and Zagreb. The HR-ZOO publication identifies the renovated HR-ZOO RI data center at the University campus Trsat in Rijeka. MEP project details list HR-ZOO Rijeka gross area of 213 m2 and designed DC power of 125 kW; DatacenterMap gives the address as Radmile Matejcic 2, Rijeka.
